props.name: format
props.comment: Text the input shows for the stored number (`null` when empty).

props.name: parse
props.comment: The number to store for the text the user typed (`null` when empty or unparseable).

props.name: min
props.comment: Lowest value the native input accepts.

props.name: max
props.comment: Highest value the native input accepts.

props.name: step
props.comment: How far the native input's spinner steps.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path (dot/bracket), relative to the ambient source scope.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default (seeds only into a hole), typed as the value at `source`.

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
